Presentation inventory is additive; fixed Phase::ALL/PHASE_COUNT and Tracy match remain exhaustive. Default no-op hooks retain previous behavior.
Reviewed tests distinguish success/failure/refresh counts and public native argument-error cleanup without launching a window; actual offline CLI execution is retained.
